official_site: UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, 1 Garrod Dr, Davis, California
eligibility: Cats age 1–15 with feline hypersomatotropism; IGF-1 screening and UC Davis surgical evaluation
intervention: Study assigns and pays for hypophysectomy; follow-up at weeks 1 and 3. Research question concerns post-excision immune/gene expression and hormone effects.
funding: Hypophysectomy covered, other surgical/anesthesia/imaging costs may be covered case by case; owner may pay hospitalization, medications, diagnostics and remaining clinical care.
decision: Not a public cancer-treatment match: primary describes a functional growth hormone secreting pituitary tumor causing endocrine disease and does not establish malignant tumor eligibility. Existing UGA pituitary scope is analogous but a different protocol, not a duplicate.
